scripts.build: npm run lint:tw-vars && tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender-routes.mjs
scripts.lint:tw-vars: ! grep -rEn '\-\[--[a-z0-9-]+\]' src/ || (echo '\n^ Tailwind v4: use duration-(--x) not duration-[--x] — bracket form is silently dropped' && exit 1)
